verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AgentMail can create many inboxes on demand and list threads across an entire organization, but neither is a bulk operation. Scaling inbox creation one call at a time and org-scoped listing are adjacent capabilities. No batch send, bulk label, bulk delete, or batch endpoint is documented, so this applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
